about: UCT Agent natural-language EQUIVALENCE corpus (Mission 2). Each intent group lists owner-style phrasings that must mean the SAME thing. Levels: (a) routing — the routed manifest carries every needed action; (b) deterministic — when the fast path / multiChart / compound reader claims a phrasing, its normalized plan equals `deterministic` (det: required — it MUST claim it); (c) final state — through the real panel with a faithful scripted model returning `model`, the FINAL board / reads / receipt satisfy `expect`. A known gap is `gaps.<a|b|c> = {id, reason, owner}` on the phrasing: that check runs as it.fails (it turns red the day the gap is fixed, so the marker must be removed). Removing or weakening an entry needs docs/agent/COMPATIBILITY-DECISIONS.md (baseline.lock.json).
